description: Update ordinary one-shot bounty details. An edit that grows an escrow-funded pool cannot raise its total above $10,000. You can modify the title, description, price, application-cutoff deadline, location, requiredLinks, applicationDetails, lifecycleMessages, liveCaptureRequirement, reactivate hidden inactive bounties, and more. The deadline stops new applications and direct uploads; completionWindowHours controls post-acceptance completion timing. To target an entire country, pass location with an ISO country code and isRemoteAllowed=false while omitting city and state. To change which countries may apply, pass supportedCountries with the full new list of ISO codes; omitting it leaves an explicit multi-country list in place (legacy bounties that only mirror a country-only location keep deriving that country from location), an empty array is stored as an explicit empty list but never lifts a country-only or on-site country restriction, and on-site bounties accept only their location country. Live capture and required-link requirements can only be changed before applications are received. applicationDetails may be changed after applications are received; existing applications keep their original answers, while future applications use the latest fields. applicationDetails are application detail items for standard application bounties only; blank rows are ignored, uploads are capped at 3 fields, acknowledgments at 5 fields, and camera-only live_video at 1 required field. lifecycleMessages can define auto-message templates for acceptance, rejection, and submission review transitions. Admin-only ongoing bounty settings are intentionally not exposed through MCP. You can also pause/unpause a bounty (status 'paused' stops new applications and outreach, including on a fully staffed bounty; status 'open' resumes it, and the resumed status is derived from its seats: open, partially_filled, or assigned when every seat is still filled), close an unassigned bounty and return its unused funding (status 'closed'), increase seats via spotsAvailable, keep pending applicants on fill via keepApplicantsOnFill, and change the per-seat clocks: the submission deadline via completionWindowHours (any whole number of hours from 1 to 720; null disables), the start commitment via startWindowMinutes (5-1440 minutes after seat confirmation in which the worker must press Start or upload evidence; null disables), and the ghost response policy via responseWindowHours (1-720 hours of silence before a seat is flagged; null removes it) plus autoExpireGhosts (auto-release the flagged seat) — every one of these only affects seats confirmed after the edit, live clocks are never re-timed; the 2-hour seat-confirmation window is fixed and only skipAcceptanceConfirmation changes it. completionQuestions (worker-answered at submission time) can be replaced only while applicationCount is 0; afterwards the request returns 409 because accepted work has snapshotted them, and toggle automatic applicant review via autoAccept (applications received while off stay pending; toggling on affects future applications only; ignored on aiManaged bounties) or adjust its mic-quality cutoff via autoAcceptMinMicScore (1-5 — applications scoring below your configured cutoff are auto-rejected, at/above proceed; null resets to the 3.0 default, below which applications only stay pending). Set or change the English speaking-proficiency gate via languageProficiencyRequirement ({ language: 'en', minimumCefr: 'A2'-'C2' }, scored by Oruk; null removes it; a new threshold applies to new applications and is re-checked when you accept pending applicants). The exclude-previous-participants list can be changed after posting: pass excludedParticipantSourceBountyIds with the full new list of up to 1000 ids of your OWN earlier bounties (an empty array clears it); the same source rules as create_bounty apply, and a bounty can never exclude itself. Use cancel_bounty for cancellation and refund handling. Work completion and payment are system-managed from escrow and payout evidence; status 'completed' and 'paid' cannot be set directly.

applicationDetails.description: Update application detail items. Blank rows are ignored. Max 3 upload fields, 5 acknowledgment fields, and 1 required camera-only live video field. Only allowed when applicationCount is 0.

allowedFileTypes.description: For file_upload fields. Supports image, docx, pdf, txt, video, and audio.
allowedFileTypes.title: maxItems(6)

description.description: Short helper text shown under the field.
description.title: maxLength(240)

id.description: Stable field ID. If omitted, the API derives one from the label.
id.title: maxLength(64)

label.description: Applicant-facing prompt text. Blank rows are ignored. Questions and uploads allow 120 characters, acknowledgments allow 200, and a live-video reading script allows 500.
label.title: maxLength(500)

maxFiles.description: For file_upload fields. Application uploads are normalized to one file per upload field.
maxFiles.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(3)

maxLength.description: Text field character limit. Default 200, max 500.
maxLength.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(500)

required.description: Whether a question, upload, or acknowledgment blocks application submission. live_video is always required.

type.description: Applicant detail item type: text, checkbox (acknowledgment), file_upload, or live_video (camera-only recording).

applicationDetails.title: maxItems(10)

autoAccept.description: Turn automatic applicant review on or off. When on, deterministic checks always run and an AI review runs only for free-text screening answers; qualified applicants are accepted, clear mismatches rejected, uncertain cases left pending. Applications received while off stay pending; toggling on affects future applications only. Ignored on aiManaged bounties.

anyOf.description: a number less than or equal to 5
anyOf.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(5)

autoAcceptMinMicScore.description: Change the minimum overall DNSMOS mic score (1-5) for automatic review on micCheckRequired bounties — applications scoring below your configured cutoff are auto-rejected, at/above proceed toward acceptance — or pass null to reset to the platform default (3.0, below which applications only stay pending). Affects future applications only.

autoExpireGhosts.description: When true (with responseWindowHours set), ghosting workers’ seats are auto-released at the deadline and the listing reopens.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty to update

completionQuestions.description: Mandatory questions the accepted WORKER answers when submitting evidence (for example "Which counter did you use?"). Max 10, prompts up to 300 characters, required defaults to true. Distinct from applicationDetails, which screens applicants before acceptance. Visible to workers before they apply. Locked once applications are received (409): accepted work snapshots the questions.

id.description: Stable question ID. If omitted, the API derives one from the prompt.
id.title: maxLength(64)

prompt.description: Worker-facing question answered when submitting evidence. Blank rows are ignored. Max 300 characters.
prompt.title: maxLength(300)

required.description: Whether the worker must answer before their submission is accepted. Default true.

completionQuestions.title: maxItems(10)

anyOf.description: a number less than or equal to 720
anyOf.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(720)

completionWindowHours.description: Auto-reassign completion deadline as any whole number of hours from 1 to 720 (30 days), or null to disable. Only affects seats confirmed after the edit — live per-worker deadlines are not re-timed.

deadline.description: New application cutoff (ISO 8601), based on the user’s schedule. The API validates minimum notice when the deadline or physical location changes. This does not retime accepted workers.

documentSubmission.description: Document-upload submission settings. Required when setting submissionMode to document_upload.

acceptText.description: a string at most 50 character(s) long
acceptText.title: maxLength(50)

confirmationMessage.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
confirmationMessage.title: maxLength(1000)

consentText.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
consentText.title: maxLength(1000)

maxDocuments.description: a number less than or equal to 10
maxDocuments.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(10)

estimatedHours.description: New estimated duration in hours (min 5 minutes = 0.083). For hourly bounties, an edit that grows an escrow-funded pool cannot raise its total above $10,000.
estimatedHours.title: greaterThanOrEqualTo(0.08333333333333333)

evidenceTypes.description: Updated evidence types. At least one required when present.
evidenceTypes.title: minItems(1)

excludedParticipantSourceBountyIds.description: Replace the exclude-previous-participants list: ids of your own earlier regular bounties (max 1000), never this bounty itself. An empty array clears it. Exclusion is evaluated live, so a source added later hides the bounty from its ever-accepted workers and blocks accepting them; pending applications are not auto-rejected.
excludedParticipantSourceBountyIds.title: maxItems(1000)

identityRequired.description: Require applicants to pass an identity check (government ID) before applying. Verified once per account and reused across bounties.

keepApplicantsOnFill.description: When true, pending applicants are kept (not auto-rejected) even after every seat escrow settles, so you can draw from the same pool after reopening or adding seats. By default applicants are already kept while seats are merely filled and are only auto-rejected at settlement. Default false.

language.description: Spoken language to assess. Only 'en' (English) is supported; other values are rejected.

minimumCefr.description: Minimum CEFR speaking band the applicant must reach: A2, B1, B2, C1, or C2. Compared against the most likely band from a scored check.

languageProficiencyRequirement.description: Require applicants to pass an English speaking-proficiency check before applying. The applicant records about 45 seconds of spontaneous speech in the app; Oruk (model oruk-proficiency-1) transcribes and scores it, and only a scored result at or above minimumCefr qualifies. Recordings the model cannot score (too little speech, low confidence) ask the applicant to retry. A worker's scored level is saved on their profile as a lasting credential, reused across every bounty without retesting (only a newer scored check replaces it), and re-checked against the bounty's current threshold at acceptance; a stored level below your threshold still requires a new recording. Shape: { language: 'en', minimumCefr: 'A2' | 'B1' | 'B2' | 'C1' | 'C2' }. Omit for no requirement. Separate from micCheckRequired. Pass null to remove the requirement. Changing the threshold applies to new applications and to every pending applicant at acceptance time.

lifecycleMessages.description: Auto-sent to the doer in the bounty conversation on lifecycle transitions. Supports {{name}}, {{bountyTitle}}, {{deadline}}, {{reason}} interpolation. Accepted/submission templates are only ever delivered to accepted applicants.

onAccepted.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onAccepted.title: maxLength(2000)

onRejected.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onRejected.title: maxLength(2000)

onSubmissionApproved.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onSubmissionApproved.title: maxLength(2000)

onSubmissionReceived.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onSubmissionReceived.title: maxLength(2000)

onSubmissionRejected.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onSubmissionRejected.title: maxLength(2000)

liveCaptureRequirement.description: Require live photo/video evidence, or null to remove the requirement.

location.description: Worker location target. Set country to an ISO country code without city or state to target every eligible worker in that country, including when remote work is allowed. Include city (and optionally state/country) for city-level targeting. Platform-blocked countries are rejected.

city.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
city.title: maxLength(100)

country.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
country.title: maxLength(100)

state.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
state.title: maxLength(100)

micCheckRequired.description: Require applicants to pass an on-device microphone quality check before applying (max 2 attempts; result visible on each application).

photoSubmission.description: Photo-upload submission settings. Required when setting submissionMode to photo_upload.

acceptText.description: a string at most 50 character(s) long
acceptText.title: maxLength(50)

confirmationMessage.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
confirmationMessage.title: maxLength(1000)

consentText.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
consentText.title: maxLength(1000)

maxImages.description: a number less than or equal to 4
maxImages.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(4)

minimumResolutionPx.description: a number less than or equal to 10000
minimumResolutionPx.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(10000)

price.description: New per-worker price (minimum $3). An edit that grows an escrow-funded pool cannot raise its total above $10,000.
price.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(1000000)

reactivate.description: Reactivate a bounty hidden by inactivity garbage collection.

requiredLinks.description: Update required links. Only allowed when applicationCount is 0.

label.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
label.title: maxLength(100)

requiredLinks.title: maxItems(10)

anyOf.description: a number less than or equal to 720
anyOf.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(720)

responseWindowHours.description: Hours an accepted worker has to show activity before their seat is treated as ghosted (1-720), or null to remove the ghost policy. Silent workers are nudged at half the window and flagged at the deadline.

spotsAvailable.description: Change the number of seats (humans needed, 1-2000). Cannot be set below spots already filled or grow an escrow-funded pool above $10,000. On a wallet-funded bounty the pool is resized in place: extra seats are debited from the poster wallet, freed seats are refunded to it.
spotsAvailable.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(2000)

anyOf.description: a number less than or equal to 1440
anyOf.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(1440)

startWindowMinutes.description: Start commitment: minutes after the worker confirms their seat (or after acceptance when skipAcceptanceConfirmation is true) by which they must press Start or upload evidence, otherwise the seat is eligible for release. Whole number of minutes from 5 to 1440 (24 hours). Distinct from the fixed 2-hour seat-confirmation window and from completionWindowHours, the submission deadline. Pass null to disable. Only affects seats armed after the edit; live start clocks are never re-timed.

status.description: New owner-managed status. Owners can pause/unpause a bounty or close it before accepting a worker. 'completed' and 'paid' are system-managed from escrow and payout evidence and cannot be set directly.

submissionMode.description: How users submit to this bounty. 'application' shows the standard application form; 'photo_upload' shows consent and image upload; 'video_upload' shows consent and video upload; 'document_upload' shows consent and document upload.

supportedCountries.description: Replace the eligible-country list with the full new list of ISO country codes (country names are also recognized), e.g. ["US", "CA", "GB", "NZ", "AU"]. Omitting it leaves an explicit multi-country list in place, so a location-only edit never drops it; legacy bounties that only mirror a country-only location keep deriving that single country from location. On-site bounties (isRemoteAllowed false) with a location country accept only that one country. An empty array is stored as an explicit empty list; it never lifts a country-only or on-site country restriction (remove location.country first), while a remote city location with a country stays unrestricted as before. When location.country is set it must appear in the list. Platform-blocked countries and unrecognized values are rejected.

items.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
items.title: maxLength(100)

supportedCountries.title: maxItems(250)

videoSubmission.description: Video-upload submission settings. Required when setting submissionMode to video_upload.

acceptText.description: a string at most 50 character(s) long
acceptText.title: maxLength(50)

confirmationMessage.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
confirmationMessage.title: maxLength(1000)

consentText.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
consentText.title: maxLength(1000)

maxVideos.description: a number less than or equal to 4
maxVideos.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(4)

walletImpactAcknowledged.description: Acknowledges the wallet impact of a wallet-funded bounty edit. Any edit that debits the poster wallet (adding seats via spotsAvailable, or raising the price) is first refused with error_code wallet_impact_confirmation_required and the exact amount; retry the same request with this set to true to apply the charge. Admins editing a bounty they do not own must also pass it for any edit that debits or credits the poster wallet.
